To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Whitehead groups of isotropic reductive algebraic groups over regular local rings are injective into the Whitehead group over their field of fractions and are A^1-invariant.

for an isotropic reductive group G over a regular domain R, which contains a field, the non-stable K^G_1(R[x])=G(R[x])/E(R[x]) functor is A^1-invariant, and if R is local, then the map K^G_0(R)->K^G_0(K), where K is the fraction field of R, is injective.
if a reductive group G has isotropic dimension >= 2 and R is either a field or a regular local ring, then the Whitehead group K_1^R(G) is A^1-invariant and, moreover, injective in the local case.
